name: Stella X. Yu
title: Professor
department: Electrical Engineering and Computer Science, Computer Science and Engineering division; adjunct Robotics
fitReason: GaitSpan (July 2026 preprint) expands a learned walking policy into speed-conditioned gait families using rhythm modulation, stride objectives and residual adaptation. PRISM (July 2026 preprint) adds explicit polynomial interactions to RL and diffusion-policy representations.

physicalEvidence.summary: The GaitSpan primary paper and project distinguish three real platforms, Booster T1, Booster K1 and Unitree G1, from five simulated configurations; examples include outdoor grass/gravel and speed transitions. PRISM separately reports an SO-101 mouse-click hardware pilot with five demonstrations and ten trials per policy, explicitly not a definitive hardware benchmark.

shortVisit.summary: Current faculty/research sources establish an active Michigan program, but no current invitation for external short-term master’s visitors was verified. Graduate/postdoctoral recruitment and prior collaborators are not evidence of summer acceptance.

scoreReasons.physical: Three specifically documented real humanoids and a separate explicitly limited arm pilot.
scoreReasons.freshness: Current Fall2026 teaching and two July2026 primary robot-learning papers.

name: Zhiyu Huang
title: Assistant Professor
fitReason: TIC-VLA (ICML 2026) addresses slow semantic reasoning versus fast robot control through latency-aware VLA training and asynchronous action execution. The concrete project connects language-conditioned robot behavior, imitation learning and RL under edge-compute constraints.

physicalEvidence.summary: The TIC-VLA primary paper evaluates a physical Unitree Go2 on four indoor/outdoor navigation tasks with human traffic, clutter, a plaza and uneven walkway. Inference uses Jetson Orin NX or RTX4060 edge hardware. The Nova Carter and Spot experiments belong to the separate DynaNav simulation benchmark.

shortVisit.summary: Current PARIS Lab homepage recruits Fall2027 PhD students and provides a professional email. No current external-master’s summer visitor/intern route was found; PhD recruitment is not scored as a short visit.

scoreReasons.fit: Strong efficient VLA/RL navigation fit; manipulation evidence still prospective.
scoreReasons.physical: Physical Go2 experiments were conducted during the preceding UCLA affiliation; new NC State lab equipment is unconfirmed.
scoreReasons.freshness: Current August2026 faculty start and ICML2026 robot-learning work.
